home.title: Is your PC in fine fettle?
home.body: Fettle reads what Windows already knows and fills in the receipt on the left. It takes about a second.
scan.failed: The check couldn't finish. Try again.
scan.busy: A check is already running. Try again in a moment.
export.copied: Copied. Paste it where you're asking for help.
preview.title: Print preview
preview.note: This is how the receipt will come out of the printer.
preview.no_printing: Windows can't print on this PC right now, so this saves a PDF instead.
export.print_off: Windows can't print on this PC right now. Save makes the same receipt as a PDF.
export.print_off_saved: Windows can't print on this PC right now, so Fettle saved the receipt as a PDF instead.
deep.why: Windows will ask for administrator access. Fettle needs it to read disk health and the security chip, and it still only reads.
deep.cancelled: The Deep check was cancelled. This is still the quick check.
deep.failed: The Deep check couldn't start. Try again.
share.title: Share this receipt
share.intro: Anyone with the link can see the receipt on the left, exactly as it is. It never includes serial numbers, the PC's name, usernames or email addresses.
share.json: Advanced: show the JSON that will be sent
share.password_note: A lost password can't be recovered. The delete link still works without it.
share.qr_hint: Scan it to open the receipt on a phone.
share.delete_keep: Shown only this once: keep it to delete the link before it expires.
share.delete_note: Fettle also keeps it on this PC, under My shared links.
share.e.network: Couldn't reach the Fettle server. Check the connection and try again.
share.e.rate_limited: Too many links in a short time. Try again later.
share.e.rate_limited_in: Too many links in a short time. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
share.e.too_large: This report is too big to share. Save it as JSON instead.
share.e.password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
share.e.password_too_long: The password can be at most 128 characters.
share.e.other: The link couldn't be created. Try again.
links.title: My shared links
links.none: No shared links on this PC.
links.deleted: Deleted. The link no longer works.
links.one_gone: 1 link was deleted on the website, so it's gone from this list.
links.some_gone: {count} links were deleted on the website, so they're gone from this list.
links.check_failed: Couldn't reach the Fettle server, so nothing was changed. Try again later.
links.already_gone: It had already been deleted on the website.
blank.label: A blank receipt: what Fettle will check
blank.storage: Each drive's health, wear and space
blank.battery: How much charge it still holds
blank.memory: How much, how fast, which slots
blank.graphics: Cards and how old their drivers are
home.reads: It only reads. Nothing is changed, and nothing is sent, apart from an update check you can turn off.
home.back_body: That was {days} days ago. Check again to see how this PC is doing today.
home.back_body_today: That was earlier today. Check again to see how this PC is doing now.
home.back_body_yesterday: That was yesterday. Check again to see how this PC is doing today.
home.kept: Kept only on this PC. You can turn this off in Settings.
deep.title: Deep check
export.json_title: Save as PDF, or the report as JSON
settings.remember: Remember the last check on this PC
settings.private: Show this PC's name and serial numbers on this screen
settings.private_hint: Only here: never on the receipt, in saved files or in shared links.
settings.updates_hint: Fettle asks its website for the latest version number. Nothing about your PC is sent.
private.kicker: This PC · only on this screen
private.none: Windows doesn't report a name or serial numbers for this PC.
theme.label: Theme
about.fonts: Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque and IBM Plex Mono (OFL)
